A search was run through old Norwegian church records held by FamilySearch, looking for the baptism of Anders Moen, born around October 1868 in Ringsaker, Hedmark, Norway. The next step is to formally extract this christening record into the research project as a sourced finding, which will anchor the parent-child relationships with original Norwegian evidence.
